response.text:
Action items (extracted + suggested owners/acceptance criteria)

1) Fix recurring Friday-afternoon deploy failures
- Action: Investigate root cause (logs, recent changes, timing/traffic patterns).  
- Owner: DevOps/Release engineer.  
- Acceptance criteria: cause identified, a fix or mitigation deployed, and a postmortem or short RCA documented.

- Action: Add automated monitoring/alerts for deploy failures and rollback capability.  
- Owner: DevOps.  
- Acceptance criteria: alerts trigger on failure, rollback documented and tested.

- Action: Consider changing deployment schedule or gating risky changes on Fridays.  
- Owner: Release manager/engineering lead.  
- Acceptance criteria: deployment policy updated and communicated.

2) Assign ownership for the staging DB
- Action: Designate a single owner (or small on-call rotation) responsible for staging DB maintenance, access, backups, and schema changes.  
- Owner: Engineering manager to assign; DB owner (named) to accept.  
- Acceptance criteria: owner assigned in writing, responsibilities documented, and contact listed in runbook.

- Action: Create a staging DB runbook (access, refresh cadence, backup/restore, troubleshooting).  
- Owner: DB owner / SRE.  
- Acceptance criteria: runbook published in repo/wiki and shared with team.

3) Create a pre-merge checklist for QA
- Action: Draft a concise pre-merge checklist covering required tests, environment verification, security checks, and release notes.  
- Owner: QA lead + senior devs.  
- Acceptance criteria: checklist approved, added to PR template, and used for new PRs.

- Action: Automate checklist items where possible (CI jobs, linters, test suites) and require CI green before merge.  
- Owner: CI/Automation owner.  
- Acceptance criteria: checklist items reflected in CI gates and PR merge blocked until passing.

4) Attendance/standup issue (Marcus)
- Action: Manager/people lead to do a private, non-judgmental check-in with Marcus to understand and offer support.  
- Owner: Marcus’s manager.  
- Acceptance criteria: check-in completed, any agreed accommodations or next steps documented.

- Action: Remind team of standup expectations and how to notify when unavailable (calendar updates, Slack status, stand-in).  
- Owner: Scrum master/product owner.  
- Acceptance criteria: team reminder sent and process documented.

- Action: If needed, arrange temporary coverage or redistribute work while situation is clarified.  
- Owner: Engineering manager/lead.  
- Acceptance criteria: coverage plan in place until issue resolved.

Note on Marcus: I can’t determine whether Marcus is dealing with a personal, health, or other issue from these notes and it would be inappropriate to speculate. Recommended next step is the private, supportive manager check-in above. If you want, I can draft a short, neutral script for that check-in.
